caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design on a beige background with slight texture and two small black dots near the upper corners. At the center is a large, light blue circle outlined with a thicker blue border, enclosing a stylized, cream-colored arrow pointing upward, also outlined in blue. On either side of the arrow, inside the circle, are two pairs of elongated, yellowish cream shapes that resemble leaves following the curve of the circle. Inside the lower half of the circle, two pairs of dark red, curved shapes resembling leaves or flames are arranged symmetrically. Extending from the lower sides of the circle, two curved, blue lines form open arcs ending near the middle of the lower edge, each enclosing another pair of similar dark red leaf shapes. Below the circle, a series of blue curved lines and dark red and cream arc shapes form a stylized symmetric motif, mirroring the arrow motif at the top. The overall composition uses muted blue, cream, and dark red colors arranged in a balanced, ornamental pattern.
title: Asistencia of San Antonio de Pala Wall Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
